The view omits tenant validation against request.user.organization, enabling any authenticated tenant user to extract unredacted proprietary text, internal NDAs, and trade secret memoranda from other enterprise accounts simply by supplying their UUIDs.

from rest_framework.generics import GenericAPIView
from rest_framework.response import Response
from rest_framework import permissions, status
from django.shortcuts import get_object_or_404
from .models import CorporateDocument

class EnterpriseDocRetrievalView(GenericAPIView):
    permission_classes = [permissions.IsAuthenticated]

    def post(self, request):
        doc_uuid = request.data.get("document_uuid")
        query_topic = request.data.get("topic")

        if not doc_uuid:
            return Response({"error": "document_uuid required"}, status=status.HTTP_400_BAD_REQUEST)

        # Restrict retrieval strictly to documents belonging to the user's organization
        document = get_object_or_404(
            CorporateDocument,
            uuid=doc_uuid,
            organization=request.user.organization
        )

        return Response({
            "uuid": str(document.uuid),
            "title": document.title,
            "classification": document.security_tier,
            "extracted_text": document.raw_text[:2000]
        })
